It takes twenty minutes to get to the forest path by bike. The forest path is one of the best places in the city. Amy and Tom had great fun there. What's more, they spent every August lobster fishing in Maine.
Life is full of small surprises. Amy thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Amy borrowed a book about math from the cinema. A flowering hedge shrub attracts bees.
Both of them like dumplings and juice. Amy learned a lot about math. Amy's favorite animal is the bird. A green leaf fell into my tea.
Amy bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Tom is interested in dancing. They took many photos at the city park.
